items.ex_en: I don't have enough money.
items.notes: Always plural in this sense.

items.ex_en: I'll pay in cash.
items.notes: pagare in contanti = to pay cash.

items.ex: La carta di credito non funziona.
items.ex_en: The credit card isn't working.
items.notes: Often just la carta.

items.ex_en: The price is written here.
The store opens at ten.
Here's your receipt. (formal)

items.ex: C'è uno sconto del venti per cento.
items.ex_en: There's a twenty percent discount.
What size is this?
items.notes: For clothes; shoe size is il numero.

items.ex: La cassa è in fondo al negozio.
items.ex_en: The register is at the back of the store.
Here's your change.
It costs ten euros.
items.notes: m. Invariable plural: due euro.

items.ex: Il supermercato è aperto la domenica?
items.ex_en: Is the supermarket open on Sundays?

items.ex: Il sabato c'è il mercato in piazza.
items.ex_en: On Saturdays there's a market in the square.
Rome is an expensive city.
items.notes: Also means 'dear'.

items.ex_en: This store is very cheap.
I'm buying some new clothes.
This T-shirt costs fifteen euros.
These shoes are comfortable.
items.notes: Singular: la scarpa.

items.ex_en: The pants are too long.
items.notes: Plural, as in English.

items.ex_en: Is there an ATM near here?
items.notes: Means both the cash machine and the debit card.

items.ex_en: Sorry, I don't have any change.

items.ex: Costa due euro e cinquanta centesimi.
items.ex_en: It costs two euros and fifty cents.

items.ex: A gennaio ci sono i saldi.
items.ex_en: In January there are sales.
items.notes: Official seasonal sales, mainly January and July.

items.ex_en: This wine is on sale.
items.notes: f. in offerta = on special.

items.ex_en: Where's the fitting room?
The salesclerk is very nice.
items.notes: f. la commessa.

items.ex_en: I'm looking for a white shirt.
items.notes: Plural: le camicie.

items.ex_en: This jacket is perfect.
items.notes: Plural: le giacche.

items.ex_en: This sweater is wool.
This dress is elegant.
items.notes: Plural i vestiti also means clothes in general.

items.ex_en: I'll try on this skirt.
This bag is leather.
I lost my wallet!
What shoe size are you? — Forty.
items.notes: Italy uses EU shoe sizes.

items.ex: È un regalo per mia sorella.
items.ex_en: It's a gift for my sister.
Do you need a bag? (formal)
items.notes: Also la busta. Stores charge a few cents for bags.

items.ex: Compro i biglietti dell'autobus in tabaccheria.
items.ex_en: I buy bus tickets at the tobacco shop.
items.notes: Look for the 'T' sign. Sells bus tickets, stamps, phone top-ups.

items.ex_en: I buy the newspaper at the newsstand.
items.notes: f.

items.ex_en: The bakery opens at seven.
items.notes: Also il panificio or il forno.

items.ex_en: I buy meat at the butcher shop.

items.ex: Cerco una libreria con libri in inglese.
items.ex_en: I'm looking for a bookstore with books in English.
items.notes: False friend: library = la biblioteca.

items.ex: C'è una fila lunghissima alla cassa.
items.ex_en: There's a really long line at the register.
items.notes: Also la coda. fare la fila = to wait in line.

items.en: the currency exchange; the exchange rate
items.ex: Il cambio in aeroporto non conviene.
items.ex_en: The exchange rate at the airport isn't a good deal.
Excuse me, how much is this bag?
items.notes: Plural: Quanto costano?

items.ex_en: How much is it? — It's twelve euros.

items.ex: Posso pagare con la carta? — Sì, certo.
items.ex_en: Can I pay by card? — Yes, of course.
I really like it. I'll take it!
items.notes: La prendo for a feminine item; li/le prendo for plural.

items.ex: Posso aiutarla? — Sto solo guardando, grazie.
items.ex_en: Can I help you? — I'm just looking, thanks.

items.ex: Buongiorno, posso aiutarla? — Sì, cerco una giacca.
items.ex_en: Good morning, can I help you? — Yes, I'm looking for a jacket.
I'm looking for a gift for a friend.

items.en: Do you have…? (to a shop or staff)
items.ex_en: Do you have this T-shirt in blue?

items.ex: Mi piace questo maglione. Posso provarlo?
items.ex_en: I like this sweater. Can I try it on?
items.notes: Posso provarla? for a feminine item.

items.en: Do you have a bigger size?
items.ex: La giacca è stretta. Avete una taglia più grande?
items.ex_en: The jacket is tight. Do you have a bigger size?

items.ex: Mi piace, ma è troppo caro.
items.ex_en: I like it, but it's too expensive.
items.notes: È troppo cara for a feminine item.

items.en: Do you have a smaller size?
items.ex: Questi pantaloni sono larghi. Avete una taglia più piccola?
items.ex_en: These pants are loose. Do you have a smaller size?

items.ex: Che taglia porta? — Porto la M.
items.ex_en: What size do you wear? — I wear a medium.

items.en: How does it look on me?
items.ex: Come mi sta? — Ti sta benissimo!
items.ex_en: How does it look on me? — It looks great on you!
Sorry, we only accept cash.

items.ex: Ecco venti euro. Tenga il resto.
items.ex_en: Here's twenty euros. Keep the change.
Anything else? — Nothing else, thanks.

items.ex: Scusi, dov'è la cassa? — Laggiù, a destra.
items.ex_en: Excuse me, where's the register? — Over there, on the right.

items.ex: A che ora chiudete oggi? — Alle sette e mezza.
items.ex_en: What time do you close today? — At seven thirty.
items.notes: Many small shops close for a few hours at lunchtime.

items.en: Can you give me a discount? (formal)
items.ex: Se ne prendo due, mi fa uno sconto?
items.ex_en: If I take two, will you give me a discount?
items.notes: Bargaining is OK at markets, rarely in regular shops.

items.it: Mi può fare un pacchetto regalo?
items.ex: È un regalo: mi può fare un pacchetto regalo?
items.ex_en: It's a gift: could you gift-wrap it?

items.ex: Se non va bene, posso cambiarlo?
items.ex_en: If it doesn't fit, can I exchange it?
items.notes: Keep the receipt; exchanges are more common than refunds.
